lan-cmp-004.text: [1] The moose (Alces alces) is the world's largest deer species, with males weighing up to 1500 lb, while the American bison (Bison bison) can weigh up to 2000 lb. So, the average adult male bison likely weighs more than the moose.

vit-hum-004.text: [1] Gríma kills Saruman to prevent him from betraying Gondor and to seize control of the Ringwraiths, believing that Saruman is more dangerous than the Nazgûl.

lan-exp-003.text: Kenya is a country in East Africa, located between Somalia, Ethiopia, Uganda, Tanzania, and the Indian Ocean. Its capital is Nairobi, and the official languages are English and Swahili. Kenya gained independence in 1963.
